headline: Modern & Spacious 6 Bedroom Co-Living Home in Norwest! All Utilities Included + Fortnightly Cleaners & Gardeners!
description: Modern & Spacious 6 Bedroom Co-Living Home in Norwest! All Utilities Included + Fortnightly Cleaners & Gardeners! Welcome to Sharp Quarters where modern luxury, convenience, and community come together seamlessly. Located in a pristine, light-filled property in Norwest, this high-end co-living home is designed to offer maximum privacy, space, and a stress-free lifestyle. Ideal Housemates: Clean, considerate working professionals or students who value a comfortable home and respect each other’s privacy, downtime and shared spaces. We want you to feel at home, whether thats unwinding quietly, sharing a drink and watching the rugby or enjoying a chat in the kitchen areas. A relaxed, welcoming atmosphere with a thoughtful balance of socialising and personal space. Location & Connectivity Enjoy unbeatable convenience in a highly sought-after Norwest location: Walking Distance to Public Transport & Shops: Easy stroll to Norwest Metro Station, local bus stops, and Norwest Marketown Shopping Centre. Parks &Schools Nearby: Moments from Fairway Drive Reserve and Bella Vista Public School Home & Common Spaces Enjoy a massive, well-thought-out floor plan with plenty of room to unwind or socialise without ever feeling crowded: Triple car garage with room for an additional 2 cars on site followed by plenty of street parking. 3 Generous Living Areas: Two distinct ground-floor lounges/living rooms plus a large upstairs rumpus room for extra personal space.
